title: Robust Model Selection for Discovery of Latent Mechanistic Processes
summary: When learning interpretable latent structures using model-based approaches, even small deviations from modeling assumptions can lead to inferential results that are not mechanistically meaningful. In this work, we consider latent structures that consist of $K_o$ mechanistic processes, where $K_o$ is unknown. When the model is misspecified, likelihood-based model selection methods can substantially overestimate $K_o$ while more robust nonparametric methods can be overly conservative.
